messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft — security & evidence commitments (post-demo recap)

Jordan — thanks again for the demo time today. As promised, summary and next steps to keep the MAP moving toward your target production date. We captured the security/evidence milestone as the critical path item, so I pulled together a short, actionable draft and attached the MAP + questionnaire template for your team.

Key points from today's call:
- Zenitas will own providing the completed SOC 2 questionnaire and the initial evidence set.
- Redwood will produce an evidence index, label artifacts for the review, and run the security Q&A session.
- Procurement/PO timelines will gate final go-forward; we flagged this during the demo.

Proposed MAP security milestones (draft):
1) Security kickoff & access list — target: 2027-05-16 — owner: Zenitas (Alice Monroe) — dependency: access to audit log bucket + list of services in scope
2) SOC 2 questionnaire returned (completed) — target: 2027-05-20 — owner: Zenitas (Alice) — dependency: internal security sign-off
3) Evidence bundle upload (labeled artifacts) — target: 2027-05-27 — owner: Zenitas (shared folder) — dependency: questionnaire answers + log access
4) Redwood evidence review & clarifying Q&A — target: 2027-06-03 — owner: Redwood (Neha/Vivek) — dependency: evidence bundle
5) Final security sign-off & readiness memo — target: 2027-06-10 — owners: Zenitas + Redwood
6) Target commercial close / contract sign — target: 2027-06-30 — dependency: PO & legal OK

Immediate asks: please confirm the Zenitas POC for security (name/email), procurement timeline for a PO/contract, and whether your team prefers the Drive folder above or a secure SFTP for uploading artifacts.

Attachments: MAP_draft_zenitas_v1.pdf (MAP draft), SOC2_questionnaire_zenitas.xlsx (template), evidence_index_template.csv (upload template)

If that looks good, I can lock in the security kickoff for the week of May 16 — propose Mon 5/17 or Tue 5/18 for a 45-min technical kickoff with your security and infra leads.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: MAP draft — security & evidence commitments (post-demo recap)

Dylan — thanks for the tight summary, really helpful. A few updates from our side:

- Confirming Alice Monroe (alice.monroe@zenitas.com) as Zenitas security POC. She'll lead the questionnaire and artifact collection.
- Procurement is cc'd — we expect an initial PO window in the 2–3 week range after receipt of an agreed SOW; I added procurement@zenitas.com here.
- We can commit to returning the completed SOC 2 questionnaire by 2027-05-20 assuming no major internal blockers.
- Audit log access: we'll provision read-only S3 access to the retention bucket by 2027-05-24. Team: please note that some logs span multiple regions; we'll flag which ones are in scope.
- Upload preference: Drive folder is fine if Redwood can restrict download access; otherwise we can use SFTP. Alice will confirm tomorrow.

On scheduling: the week of 5/17 looks good. Alice prefers Tue 5/18 10:00 PT for the 45-min review — can your team host a screen share for initial artifact walk-through?

Also, two asks for your MAP: please add an item for "procurement/contract touchpoint" with an owner and a suggested date so procurement has clarity.

Thanks — looping in Alice for one-line confirmation.

—Jordan
VP, Product — Zenitas Health

We'll host the kickoff + artifact walk-through on Tue 2027-05-18 at 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent). Please confirm attendees and whether Drive or SFTP will be used for upload (Alice indicated she'll confirm by EOD).

Updated MAP snapshot (security path):
- 2027-05-16: Security kickoff access list finalized — owner: Zenitas (Alice) — status: in progress
- 2027-05-18 10:00 PT: Security kickoff & artifact walk-through (45 min) — owner: Redwood (Neha) — calendar invite: https://calendar.example/ical/zenitas-kickoff

Immediate requests for Zenitas:
- Confirm Drive vs SFTP by EOD 2027-05-11
- Confirm attendees for 5/18 kickoff (Alice + one infra engineer recommended)

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.
